facts.text: Best sirloin below Canal. Keep the receipts, fellas.
facts.why: Frazier never says this and it is set in quote marks. It is an invented line.
facts.fix: Set it as an unquoted catering memo: Keep the receipts.

facts.why: Frazier and the police do put food outside the bank, but the film sends in pizzas for the hostages and no source shows Frazier eating knishes on the street.
facts.fix: lunch on the street outside the bank

facts.text: lunch for the cops on the barricade
facts.why: The police send pizzas into the bank for the hostages. Nothing shows cops being fed halal cart chicken and rice on a barricade.
facts.fix: street cart lunch for the cops outside the bank

vibe.verdict: A clean New York deli menu with box No. 392 as a nice nod, but the heist itself feels a step away.
missing: Pizzas with bugs in the boxes
Painter overalls and masks on the hostages
ideas: Swap 'Party pizzettes' note for 'Delivered with a bug in the box.'
Swap 'Italian combo' note for 'Painters' overalls optional.'
Swap the quote by Frazier for 'I'll only say this once.' signed Dalton Russell.
Add the hostages' matching overalls to the catering slip.
